data_description.dry_run: Leave on until a test import looks right.
data_description.fresh_keywords: New products whose name contains one of these get the fresh due days. Chilled goods are detected automatically. A leading “-” excludes, e.g. -canned.
data_description.location_chilled_id: Picnic marks chilled goods. Automatic = a location named Fridge/Kühlschrank.
data_description.fresh_product_group_id: Lets automations treat fresh goods separately. Automatic = a group named Frischware/Fresh.
data_description.daily_time: Picnic is asked once a day at this time.
data_description.delivery_sensor: 'Last order delivery time' of the Picnic integration. When it changes, the delivery is checked a few times over the next hours. Empty = found automatically.
